newsitem.title: USA: AMD launches new K6 chip.
newsitem.headline: AMD launches new K6 chip.

text.p: Advanced Micro Devices Wednesday said it has begun shipments of its sixth-generation AMD-K6 MMX processor.

In a statement, the company said it has already shipped thousands of units and is accelerating production in order to ship hundreds of thousands of AMD-K6 devices this quarter and millions more during the balance of the year.
Advanced Micro said the AMD-K6 processor is the fastest x86 processor for desktop computers.
Industry analysts expect the chip to allow Advanced Micro to compete more effectively with industry giant Intel Corp's oferings.
AMD-K6 family members introduced today include products at clock frequencies of 233, 200 and 166 MHz.
